_note: QP + L1 (lambda = 0.25, dense Q), 256x256 ICNN: supervised value + 5 * gradient labels from exact (FISTA) prox solves; every distinct iterate of each exact sMEL-ADMM run (sLME_ADMM stopping test, tol 1e-2, feas_tol 1e-6) is a sample (full trajectories, 40000/10000 samples from separate train/test instance streams); no self-supervised term since L1 is nonsmooth. Selects the best epoch on the test split at each lr transition, so the epoch-5000 save equals a 5000-epoch run; writes <output>-5000ep.npz and <output>-10000ep.npz.
